Dialogue.Page: Oh hey, it's you again! You saved my life!
During the time jump, something came loose above and fell down directly where I was standing! I can't imagine what would have happened if I was still standing there...

DialogueOption.Text: Now that you have had more time, how is the sun stabiliser going?

Dialogue.Page: No, sorry, LeeSpork forgot to finish making the mod, so I can't actually save the world yet.

Imagine we used the North pole's radio communications equipment to coordinate sending both sun stabiliser stations into opposite low solar orbits... Then the past planet doesn't go back, so then both planets live together in harmony ever after. Just like in Ed.
And then I would be able to take all the credit for saving the world. All me, Bruce. Yes. You get nothing.
It umm... it is still only half as powerful as it needs to be to save the sun. This is not good...

DialogueOption.Text: What if you launched two sun stabilisation stations?

Dialogue.Page: Hmm... That would work. We would just need to coordinate the launches so that they are launched in sync with each other.
By the way, the Dry Dock's launch sequence is connected to the planet's communications centre. Perhaps you should go check out the North pole and meet Corey if you haven't already.
But that is all hypothetical, we only have the one sun stabiliser-<Pause=1> Or... Hmm...
I am traumatised for life after my near-death experience.
I heard the world is ending, so I'm not sure I will see you later...
